groundDetail: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one square PBR base-color ground material atlas for a realistic temperate island game. Exactly 2 columns and 2 rows, each quadrant edge-to-edge with NO borders, gutters, labels or text. Four independent seamlessly repeatable orthographic textures. Top left: dark brown damp silty mud, subtly mottled wet earth with fine irregular shallow impressions, no footprints, no standing water or shiny highlights. Top right: natural gray-beige gravel with many irregular small angular mineral fragments 1 to 4 centimeters across, mixed grit and earthy fines, not cobblestones or round decorative stones. Bottom left: rich woodland moss ground, dense fine muted olive moss cushions with a few tiny leaf fragments and organic dark gaps, no large plants. Bottom right: dry late-summer meadow ground with golden-brown fine grass thatch mixed with subdued green blades and earth, viewed straight down. Photorealistic material detail, naturally varied but consistent game scale, uniform diffuse overcast lighting suitable for base color, no cast shadows, no baked directional lighting, no perspective, no objects, no watermark. Target 2048 square atlas; each tile independently tileable.
grassDetail: Photorealistic game vegetation alpha texture atlas, 2 columns 2 rows equally sized without borders or text, TRANSPARENT background. Each quadrant contains an isolated rooted upright grass tuft with all stems reaching the bottom of its own quadrant and empty transparent space around its silhouette. Top left dense fine green meadow grass, blades of varying lengths bending naturally. Top right taller wild grass with delicate tan seed heads above slender green blades. Bottom left dry straw-gold grass mixed with muted olive blades, natural unruly tuft. Bottom right low clover groundcover with small rounded leaves and a few tiny white clover flowers. Front orthographic view, realistic botanical detail, subdued temperate colors, uniform diffuse lighting with no cast shadow, no soil, no pot, no background, no watermark. Full tuft silhouettes must fit inside each tile with small transparent side margins. 2048 square.
bush: Use case photorealistic-natural game foliage alpha material. One isolated natural hazel and bramble leafy twig spray for temperate woodland bush cards, square transparent background. About 25 distinct broad hazel leaves, rounded ovate serrated leaves and a few smaller bramble leaves attached to fine woody branching twigs, irregular roughly circular spread with visible translucent gaps and open silhouette. Muted rich olive and medium green, subtle veins, a few light undersides, a very small inconspicuous green berry cluster. Straight-on orthographic botanical detail, uniform diffuse shadowless lighting appropriate for game base color, no baked cast shadows, no scene, no pot, no soil, no text, no watermark. Whole cluster fits inside frame with transparent margins and transparent spaces between leaves.
